abstract: Covers Internet Message Format. RFC 5322 Internet Message Format is current; RFC 2045 Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) Part One: Format of Internet Message Bodies is current; RFC 2046 Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) Part Two: Media Types is current; RFC 2047 MIME (Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions) Part Three: Message Header Extensions for Non-ASCII Text is current; RFC 2048 Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) Part Four: Registration Procedures is current; RFC 2049 Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) Part Five: Conformance Criteria and Examples is current. Requirements are quotes from the pinned text. SKILL.md holds the workflow; references split versions and the quoted requirements.

versions.revision: RFC 6838, Best Current Practice, January 2013. Obsoletes RFC 4288. Defines media type registration for HTTP, MIME and other protocols.

versions.revision: RFC 4289, Best Current Practice, December 2005. Obsoletes RFC 2048 for IANA registration of MIME external body access types and content-transfer-encodings.
